verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's own docs show that store owners create API accounts under Settings > API Accounts with "the scopes you need." The platform offers three OAuth-based credential types (store, app and account level), so an agent can be given a scoped, least-privilege credential. The evidence is thin, though: just a quick-start line and an overview sentence. missing for 10: a detailed list of scope granularity (read-only vs modify per resource), documented credential revocation, rotation or expiry, and independent or hands-on corroboration of least-privilege use for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote:
Navigate to **Settings > API Accounts** in your store
control panel. Create credentials with the scopes you need.
BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce's REST APIs: store-level credentials, app-level credentials, and account-level credentials.
